label: Arrival at S1 (D2) after not having been in S1 last trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and 99.5% of its mass is on steps where the reached state shown is S1 (it almost never fires when S2 is shown, and never at D1 or GO). Within S1 arrivals it is strongly gated by time in the episode: rate is 10% in trials 0-9, falls steadily, and it is essentially silent after trial ~60. The strongest activations are S1 arrivals that are new or unexpected: the previous trial went to S2 (prev_state != 1), the transition was rare (a2 led to S1), or the previous trial was unrewarded. Repeated S1 visits after a rewarded S1 trial are mostly silent or weak. Predicate D2 & S1 & ep_trial<40 & prev_state!=1 gives dev F1 0.72 (P 0.67, R 0.79, mass recall 0.87). Adding (common==0 | prev_reward==0) as alternatives gives F1 0.75. The agent model policy logit at D2 does not explain it. All variables are observed at D2, so no FUTURE variable is used. Magnitude is larger for the first S1 arrival after S2 visits and when it is earlier in the episode.
